infotexts.entitydescription.artifact_slot_headset: A slotted auto-injecting headset built from alien materials.\nEffects: Immortality / Respawn / Teleport / Buff Chip\nEffects are provided by the inserted chips and medicine
infotexts.afflictiondescription.custom_IgnoredByEn: With your vitality spent you are all but a corpse, yet the immortal blessing makes you vanish completely from the monsters' eyes
infotexts.afflictiondescription.custom_reaperstax: Even if you cannot die, endless frailty will haunt you...
infotexts.afflictiondescription.custom_miraclework: Even when your vitality has completely withered, you will not yield to death\n(except to the deconstructor)
infotexts.afflictiondescription.custom_pressuresta: You cannot be killed by water pressure, but will suffer from severe organ damage and deep tissue damage
infotexts.entitydescription.maxhealth_chip: When loaded into the Alien Chip Slot Headset, Increases maximum HP
infotexts.entitydescription.respawn_chip: When loaded into the Alien Chip Slot Headset, the wearer gains Respawn Blessing once their vitality falls low enough, continuously healing their afflictions and The Price for a short time\nEach trigger drains the chip's condition and puts it on cooldown
infotexts.entitydescription.teleport_chip: When loaded into the Alien Chip Slot Headset, the wearer is teleported to the nearest respawn point once their vitality falls low enough (no teleport inside a submarine)\nIf the wearer dies, the body is brought back to the ship\nEach trigger drains the chip's condition and puts it on cooldown
infotexts.entitydescription.buff_chip: When loaded into the Alien Chip Slot Headset, the wearer gains Efficient Drag and can drag incapacitated units quickly
infotexts.entitydescription.immortal_chip: When loaded into the Alien Chip Slot Headset, the wearer gains the same effects as Miracle In Progress and Pressure Immunity
infotexts.afflictiondescription.custom_respawnbles: Recovering from the brink of death...
infotexts.afflictiondescription.custom_respawnread: Grants Respawn Blessing once vitality falls low enough, continuously healing afflictions and The Price for a short time
infotexts.afflictiondescription.custom_respawncool: The Respawn Chip cannot be triggered right now
infotexts.afflictiondescription.custom_teleportrea: Teleports you to the nearest respawn point once vitality falls low enough (no teleport inside a submarine)
infotexts.afflictiondescription.custom_teleportcoo: The Teleport Chip cannot be triggered right now
infotexts.pluginsetting.teleport_threshold.name: Teleport Chip: trigger threshold (%)
infotexts.pluginsetting.teleport_threshold.desc: Triggers the teleport when vitality (in %, range -100 to 0) drops to or below this value. No teleport while inside the main submarine.
infotexts.pluginsetting.respawn_threshold.name: Respawn Chip: trigger threshold (%)
infotexts.pluginsetting.respawn_threshold.desc: Starts the resuscitation sequence when vitality (in %, range -100 to 0) drops to or below this value.
infotexts.pluginsetting.teleport_cooldown.name: Teleport Chip: cooldown (s)
infotexts.pluginsetting.teleport_cooldown.desc: Seconds between two triggers. Range 10 to 600.
infotexts.pluginsetting.respawn_cooldown.name: Respawn Chip: cooldown (s)
infotexts.pluginsetting.respawn_cooldown.desc: Seconds between two triggers. Range 10 to 600.
infotexts.pluginsetting.teleport_chip_loss.name: Teleport Chip: condition cost per use (%)
infotexts.pluginsetting.teleport_chip_loss.desc: Percentage of the chip's maximum condition consumed by one trigger (player wearer). Range 5 to 100.
infotexts.pluginsetting.teleport_chip_loss_bot.nam: Teleport Chip: condition cost per use, NPC (%)
infotexts.pluginsetting.teleport_chip_loss_bot.des: Same as above, used when the wearer is an NPC. Range 5 to 100.
infotexts.pluginsetting.respawn_chip_loss.name: Respawn Chip: condition cost per use (%)
infotexts.pluginsetting.respawn_chip_loss.desc: Percentage of the chip's maximum condition consumed by one trigger (player wearer). Range 5 to 100.
infotexts.pluginsetting.respawn_chip_loss_bot.name: Respawn Chip: condition cost per use, NPC (%)
infotexts.pluginsetting.respawn_chip_loss_bot.desc: Same as above, used when the wearer is an NPC. Range 5 to 100.
